title: Chapter 966
paragraphs: Chapter 966
Episode 238. Atonement and Letter (3)
-"...Barisada, the sword of Gaju. That's what the fake Murakan is after."
-"Eh? Barisada? Why does that fake guy want it?"
-"In the past, Soldeuret told Gaju that Barisada is not just a sword, but also a key to somewhere."
-"Barisada is a key…? I've never heard of that."

-"We also only recently learned this from the butler. We don't know exactly where the key leads to, but we've only heard that it must never fall into the hands of the fake Murakan or the witch. It's said that a great danger would befall the world..."
Conversations held within Keitam's painting.

That was a question even at that time. It was information that even Picon, who forged Barisada, did not know. Neither Luret, the survivor of Runkandel a thousand years ago, nor Veil knew anything about it.
"I thought that the information about Barisada being a key might be a mistake caused by contamination of Mr. Keitam's painting, but you confirmed it yourself."
"[Lokia Ganesto ... I didn't expect this name to appear in Gaju's letter.]"
Jin and Luret said. The group read the rest of the letter.
(Soldeuret's voice told me about that space.
It wasn't a direct explanation but a kind of record. I think that if the person who possesses Barisada reaches a certain point in the Black Sea abyss, they can find out.
Anyhow, Soldeuret defined Lokia Ganesto as a traitor, and said that if we reach the end of the Black Sea abyss, we can know the location of that space.
I couldn't know why that space existed and what was inside it. However, whatever it was, it wouldn't have a good influence on our family.
So, the expedition and I are now trying to find clues about that space, as well as subduing the Five Kings of the Black Sea.
In the meantime, you gather information related to Lokia Ganesto in the human world. If he is still alive, make him pay for the betrayal a thousand years ago.)
"Soldeuret's voice. It seems that there were records in the Black Sea just like in Temar's tomb ..."
Suddenly, the 'messages' Soldeuret left in the human world felt strange.

He had already appointed Jin as the last contractor a thousand years ago, and all the tombs of Temar found so far seemed to be the heritage he left for Jin. Even now, he has left a record in the Black Sea.
Then Soldeuret must have foreseen all of this a thousand years ago.

"Not only was Jin becoming the last contractor, but he was also meant to find Thamar's Tomb as he grew, and even a thousand years later, the head of the family would confirm the record about Rokia in the depths of the Black Sea.

'Ameris once said that the Sun God transcends space and time. If Solterlet is one of the largest fragments of the Sun God, or even a part of it, he might possess such transcendent properties. But then was the Solterlet, who communicated with me in my previous life, all an act?'
There was no way to gauge why Solterlet had left all kinds of cryptic clues in such a complex form.
However, Solterlet's 'intention' was clear.
He wanted Runecandel to not fall to enemies like Ziphil or Ganesto. All the records and clues left by Solterlet so far were evidence of that.
'There's no need to overthink. Even if the method is complicated and ambiguous, the intention is clear, so we just need to use the heritage left by Solterlet to protect our family.'
Siron, who was writing the letter at that time, was also thinking the same thing.

(I don't know why the God of Sword and Shadows left such difficult signals. Originally, Solterlet even blessed Ziphil after leaving Runecandel in the past, so there must be some circumstances. Unless he's trying to destroy me and my family.
Even if he's a god who has been with Runecandel since the days of the first head of the family, and even though he's left clues for Runecandel again,
We can't just blindly believe.
As a contractor, you would have received much more guidance than I did. Even if Solterlet approaches more clearly than now, always make a cool judgement. What is for the family.
Like all other families and people, Runecandel sometimes relied on the blessing of the gods, but in the end, we protected the family with our sword and struggle.
Never forget that fact.)
"Wow, he really is nagging."
At Luna's words, Jin nodded. Siron's letter was making all of his children, not just Jin, feel closer to him.

(…I felt that many strong people are waking up in the world. One powerful and ancient wizard against Ziphil has awakened, and two beings seem to be related to your other brothers, the Myungwangs. I also felt the dangerous aura emitted by powerful beings from somewhere not on the ground, which I've never visited.
This is why I sent Luna and some of the black knights back to the family, as Luna would have told you.
Calm them down.
Kill those who are to become harm, and save those who can be benefit, forging them harshly into a sword for the family.
In your era, not one person, but the entire family must stand alone in the sky.)"
Look forward and wait in anticipation.
P.S: It might be good for Luna to experience a severe defeat at least once. Little one, you help her.

Runtia must have regained her sanity by now. When she was tormented by the magic fever, I occasionally chuckled at the absurdity of remembering your intense eyes. If that face comes back, she should leave the family.
Mary, I regret that you never challenged me. If I'm gone, feel free to thrust your sword at me anytime.
Daytona and Haytona, you two try to resemble Uncle Zed at least half. When Zed arrived alone in the Black Sea, you can't even imagine how moved I was. Zed was less talented than you two.
Yona doesn't have to do anything. If the life of anonymity satisfies you, you can stay there. However, wherever you are, you are the 13th generation of Runkandel from today.)
The letter ended like that.

The brothers stared at the letter silently for a while. Especially, the Tona brothers were shedding tears. During the desolate times, Siron was cold to almost all of his children, but he didn't even treat the Tona brothers like humans. The sisters giggled and pointed fingers.
"Ah, these little ones."
"Huh? Jin was crying just a moment ago, Sister Mary."
"Are you guys and Jin the same? Stop crying because it's unpleasant to see."
"Okay."
For the brothers, Siron's attitude towards them was more shocking than the information about Rokia.
"I only heard from my sister that father had overcome the magic fever, but it's surprising to experience it firsthand. Khan, the expedition members must have felt very strange, right?"
"I did, third generation. But surprisingly, the senior Black Knights adapted quickly. Probably because they were taken care of by the house owner before he fell into the magic fever."
"Oh, that could be the case. Well, anyway, it seems necessary for sister to be defeated... and harshly at that. And it would be nice if the youngest could help?"
No matter how heartwarming the letter was, it was a matter of pride for Luna. Runtia grinned broadly and observed Luna's reaction.
"The youngest has ascended to Changseong, so he's probably stronger than me."
"Probably? Jin is definitely stronger, sister. But it's hard to imagine you losing to someone."
"Well, I wanted to have a proper fight with the youngest one. But not now. We should do it only when there's absolutely no gap in the defense even if we get seriously hurt."
"I also think so. I don't think Father would have wanted me and my sister to directly compete. As Luna said, the situation is too turbulent."
"Then what did Father mean when he asked the youngest to help you?"
At that, Luna shrugged her shoulders.
"Well... I don't know. Starting from the limit on the number of red sword auras, it feels like he's continually posing riddles. Khan, do you have any clue?"
"Unfortunately not, 1st in line."
"You seem to have something on your mind. I won't press further as it seems to be important."

"Anyway, the powerful beings mentioned by Father... the strong one related to the Nameless Clan must be Luke from the Church of the Sun God. He put Shino in danger and threatened Ayulra. But if there are two, could the other one be the War God of the Jeokmyeong Clan?"
The powerful ones in 'somewhere not on the ground' that Si-Ron mentioned must refer to the defeated Jito and his subordinates.
"We have not been able to pay much attention to the Jeokmyeong Clan recently while subjugating the Demon World. They are currently waging war with the Rute Empire without disturbing our territory."
Currently, due to the blockade imposed by Kelliac on the entire federation, it has become even more difficult to gather information about the Jeokmyeong Clan.

Of course, by deploying the highest power of the Nameless, including Yona, they could get proper information. But Yona was still tracking and observing Kinselo, which was why he could not be present here.
"Whether it's the Jeokmyeong Clan or whatever, this person must also be at the level of a star-rising grade, so we always have to be vigilant."
"Yes. I felt it desperately when fighting with Paelito. He was even more difficult than Jito."
Jin folded Si-Ron's letter again.

"Khan, prepare a reply right away while resting. I think I have a lot to say in the letter. Especially about Ganesto... It seems Father does not know that our deceased brothers, including Joshua, have been resurrected and are active thanks to Ganesto's power."
"...Is that true?"
"That's right. According to the letter, Lokiya Ganesto did betray Rune Kandel a thousand years ago. And he has been secretly threatening us ever since."
"We must inform the Clan Head quickly. Let me know when the reply is ready."
After that, Jin filled out the letter for a solid five hours.
It felt like he was letting go of the pent-up feelings from his past life. He had so much to say, not just about Ganesto, the current Jito, and the current situation of the family.
"I'll see you again next time, Deputy Head."
Khan, full of dry rations, mounted his horse. Those food supplies would be the sweetest entertainment for the expedition members.
"I'll be waiting with anticipation."
With a bright smile, Khan turned his horse towards the Black Sea.
